Debug Access TokenUpdated: Jun 4, 2025The /debug_token endpoint returns metadata about a given access token. This includes data such as the user for which the token was issued, whether the token is still valid, when it expires, and what permissions the app has for the given user.To access this endpoint, it is required to provide a user access token from a Threads tester, and this access token must be associated with the same app that is linked to the input_token being inspected.Retrieve an Access Token’s Datacurl -i -X GET \  "https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/debug_token?access_token=<THREADS_TESTER_ACCESS_TOKEN>&input_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN_TO_BE_INSPECTED>"
Name

Description
Required.
Threads Graph API user access token of a Threads tester.Required.
The access token to be inspected (does not need to be a Threads tester but must be associated with the same app as the access_token parameter).Note: The access_token and input_token can be associated with different users but must be associated with the same app.{  "data": {    "type": "USER",    "application": "Threads API Test App",    "data_access_expires_at": 1754846089,    "expires_at": 1752254132,    "is_valid": true,    "issued_at": 1747070132,    "scopes": [      "threads_basic",      "threads_content_publish",      "threads_manage_replies",      "threads_manage_insights",      "threads_read_replies",      "threads_manage_mentions",      "threads_keyword_search",      "threads_location_tagging"    ],    "user_id": "1234567890123456"  }}
Name

Description
Data wrapper around the result.Whether the access token is an app access token or user access token.Name of the application this access token is for.data_access_expires_at
Unixtime

Timestamp when the app’s access to user data expires.Timestamp when this access token expires.Whether the access token is still valid or not.Timestamp when this access token was issued.List of permissions that the user has granted for the app in this access token.The ID of the user this access token is for.
